notes.title: Celebrity Hunter - Episode 5
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.com/channels/1225680118265937962/1225680118265937964][b]Click here to join our Discord to know more about Celebrity Hunter![/b][/url]

The most intense and exhilarating chapter yet has arrived in Celebrity Hunter Episode 5!

Your fourth encounter with Priscila takes a surprising turn, but the captivating conclusion will leave you breathless.

[b]Meet Miranda, the Model's Agent[/b]

Will you succumb to temptation and flirt with Miranda, even as you pursue a romance with her client? Your actions will have far-reaching consequences.

[b]Defy the Powerful Gustav Aldebaran[/b]

Dare to challenge the formidable director Gustav Aldebaran and his imposing bodyguard Marco to continue your love affair with Priscila? The consequences could be disastrous.

[b]Seize Your Chance for Love[/b]

The opportunity to finally declare your love for Priscila is within reach, but it all hinges on the choices you've made throughout your journey.

[b]Uncover Hidden Secrets and Gadgets[/b]

Seek out hidden devices scattered throughout the episode to unravel the mysteries of the story and intensify the gameplay.

notes.title: Clebrity Hunter Release Schedule
notes.notes:
From the indie studio Geiko Games, we're thrilled to bring our most celebrated title, Celebrity Hunter, to the PC audience on Steam! Embark on an enthralling interactive adult adventure filled with intrigue, suspense, and captivating characters.

To ensure Steam players receive a game packed with content that will draw you into the lives of our characters and immerse you in this captivating story, we've set the official Steam release date for Celebrity Hunter to [b]November 1st[/b].

Eager to dive into the world of Celebrity Hunter before the official launch? [url=https://discord.gg/yJTSVTX2Rj][b]Join our official Discord community[/b][/url] to connect with fellow fans, follow the development process closely, participate in testing, provide feedback, and share your thoughts on what you'd like to see in the game.

[url=https://discord.gg/yJTSVTX2Rj][b]Click here to join our Discord and embark on this journey with us![/b][/url]
